note: Historical event template DATA for the events engine. date is UTC ISO date; scenario converts to minutes via startDate. Sources resolve against scenario sources[].

events.title: Germany attacks in the West
events.body: German forces invade the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. Army Group A begins its advance through the Ardennes; airborne troops land around The Hague, Rotterdam and Eben-Emael.
effectHints: Allied 1st Army Group may begin Plan D advance

events.title: Guderian reaches Sedan
events.body: XIX Panzer Corps enters Sedan. The Meuse line is now directly threatened.

events.title: The Meuse is crossed at Sedan
events.body: After an eight-hour Luftwaffe bombardment, the 1st, 2nd and 10th Panzer Divisions cross the Meuse at Gaulier, Donchery and Wadelincourt. French morale at Sedan collapses.
effectHints: Morale penalty to French units near Sedan

events.title: Rotterdam bombed
events.body: The Luftwaffe bombs Rotterdam; German forces threaten further cities.

events.title: The Netherlands capitulates
events.body: The main Dutch forces surrender. Fighting continues in Zeeland until 17 May. (S09 summary gives 14 May for the surrender; S06 gives 15 May.)
effectHints: NED units removed from play except Zeeland until 17 May

effects.text: The Netherlands has capitulated; Dutch field forces are disbanded (Zeeland resistance to 17 May is abstracted away, S09).

events.effectsNote: Restates S06/S09: main Dutch forces surrendered and the cities passed to German control. Zeeland holdout to 17 May is not modelled.

events.title: German armour reaches the Channel
events.body: Panzer units reach the coast around Abbeville, separating the Allied northern armies from the south.
effectHints: Allied northern armies cut off from southern supply

events.title: Counter-attack at Arras
events.body: British Frankforce (1st Army Tank Brigade with elements of the 5th and 50th Divisions) attacks the flank of the German advance near Arras. It is withdrawn after dark but unsettles the German high command.

events.title: Halt order before Dunkirk
events.body: Hitler approves a halt order issued the previous night by Rundstedt; it is rescinded on 26 May.
effectHints: German armour held back from the Dunkirk pocket until 26 May

events.title: Operation Dynamo begins; Calais falls
events.body: Evacuation from Dunkirk begins. The British garrison at Calais surrenders the same day.

events.title: Belgium capitulates
events.body: King Leopold III surrenders the Belgian Army, against the advice of his government.

effects.text: King Leopold III has surrendered the Belgian Army; Belgian forces cease to fight.

events.effectsNote: Restates S14: Belgian army capitulated on 28 May. No territory transfer is scripted because the sources retrieved do not date the fall of individual Belgian cities.

events.title: Operation Dynamo ends
events.body: The evacuation ends after 338,226 Allied troops were lifted from Dunkirk and the surrounding beaches.

events.title: Fall Rot begins
events.body: Germany launches the second phase against the French defence line on the Somme and Aisne.

events.title: Italy declares war; Paris declared an open city
events.body: Italy enters the war against France and Britain. Paris is declared an open city.
effectHints: ITA enters war on Axis side (Alpine front)

events.title: Surrender at Saint-Valery-en-Caux
events.body: The 7th Panzer Division forces the surrender of the British 51st (Highland) Division and French IX Corps.

events.title: German troops enter Paris
effectHints: Paris transfers to Germany if undefended

events.title: Operation Tiger and Operation Aerial
events.body: Army Group C attacks across the Rhine against the Maginot Line (Operation Tiger). British evacuation from French Atlantic ports (Operation Aerial) begins and runs to 25 June.

events.title: Reynaud resigns; Pétain takes office
events.body: Paul Reynaud resigns and is succeeded by Marshal Pétain.

events.title: Armistice signed at Compiègne
events.body: France and Germany sign an armistice; it takes effect at 00:35 on 25 June.
